description:
Hi! I'm an LLM Engineer with a background in Biomedical Sciences, currently pursuing an MSc in Health Data Science.

For this challenge, I'd love to build something useful around astronaut health monitoring, combining AI, data analysis, and an intuitive dashboard.

I'm looking for star teammates with an interest in coding, design, space science, or data visualization. All experience levels are welcome!

Let's build something we're proud of!
